title: ADP Lyric HCM Is Now Accessible to Companies across Key European Markets
summary: AI-enabled platform makes managing a global workforce simpler by bringing HR, payroll, and workforce management together with localized compliance support and workforce intelligence. The solution is now available to companies headquartered in France, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Germany, as well as to subsidiaries in 140 countries and territories.
